# v1.0.1 — packaging release

Runtime behavior is identical to `v1.0.0`; the reconcile loop, DNS provider
contract, and CLI surface are unchanged. `v1.0.1` exists because `v1.0.0`
was tagged ahead of the Phase 5 docs-and-deploy work landing on `main`, so
this is the first release that goes through the end-to-end pipeline — it
ships the reference Docker image, cross-compiled Linux tarballs, an SBOM
per archive, the release workflow that produced them, and the docs set
that describes how to operate the daemon.

## What's new

- **Docker image.** Multi-stage distroless build published as
  `ghcr.io/rootwarp/ddns:v1.0.1` and `ghcr.io/rootwarp/ddns:latest`,
  multi-arch manifest covering `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.
- **Binary archives.** `ddns_v1.0.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz` and
  `ddns_v1.0.1_linux_arm64.tar.gz`, each bundling `README.md`, `LICENSE`,
  `config.example.yaml`, the `deploy/` tree (Dockerfile + compose) and
  the `docs/` tree (operations guide, log-event taxonomy,
  getting-started-gcp).
- **SBOM.** CycloneDX SBOM emitted per archive — attached to the release
  assets so downstream consumers have a supply-chain manifest.
- **Checksums.** `checksums.txt` with SHA256 over every archive asset.
- **Operations guide.** `docs/operations.md` — day-two procedures
  (deploy, upgrade, reload config via `SIGHUP`, state migration, key
  rotation, troubleshooting).
- **Release-gate runbook.** `plan/bootstrap/release-gate-runbook.md` —
  the pre-flight, soak, documentation, tag, and post-tag checklist that
  gates every future release.

## Install

```sh
# Docker
docker pull ghcr.io/rootwarp/ddns:v1.0.1

# go install (macOS / any host with a Go toolchain)
go install github.com/rootwarp/ddns/cmd/ddns@v1.0.1
```

See `README.md` and `docs/getting-started-gcp.md` for end-to-end setup on
Google Cloud DNS.

## Upgrade

No config migration required. Replace the image tag (`:v1.0.0` →
`:v1.0.1`) or the binary and restart. State files from `v1.0.0` are
read-compatible.

## Not included (deferred)

- **Artifact signing.** Cosign / keyless signing is Phase 8 — tracked as
  a follow-up (targeting `v1.2`).
- **macOS / Windows binaries.** Linux is the only supported deploy shape.
  Mac users with a Go toolchain can `go install` the binary directly.
- **Homebrew tap.** Not planned for v1.
- **Cloudflare provider.** Targeted for `v1.1`; `v1.x` ships with Google
  Cloud DNS only.
